page: Amazon Web Services m8ib.metal-96xl is a bare-metal, general-purpose server powered by 192 physical cores and 384 dedicated vCPUs on Intel x86_64 architecture running at 3.9 GHz. It features 1536.0 GB of system memory, providing a uniform allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Operating directly on bare-metal hardware without hypervisor layer virtualization, the instance delivers complete access to all compute and memory resources.

The server contains no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage configurations for persistent disk needs. High-volume data transfers are supported by a 400 Gbps baseline network bandwidth interface. The configuration excludes GPU hardware accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The combination of 384 vCPUs and a 400 Gbps network pipe yields significant resource density for large deployments. While the absence of local NVMe storage mandates reliance on external storage architectures, the high network bandwidth accommodates demanding remote block storage and distributed node communication. The server fits high-scale enterprise systems, distributed databases, large-footprint container clusters, and heavy computational pipelines.
